snxx29.selection_rule: Exact type == "SNxx29"; 10 L + 10 R; acetylcholine model transmitter.
snxx29.identity_evidence: ppk+/Gr28b.d+ heat-nociceptive leg sensory identity is inferred from MANC-era annotation literature. MaleCNS v1.0 has no receptorType for these cells and the MaleCNS paper (Berg et al.) does not describe SNxx29 or nociception.

random-matched.selection_rule: For each SNxx29 cell, one draw without replacement from the 3 nearest same-side sensory neurons (superclass vnc_sensory, subclass leg, acetylcholine, non-modulatory, not SNxx29) by outgoing synapse count; whole draws repeated from the seeded generator until total outgoing synapses are within 10%.

random-dose-matched.selection_rule: For each SNxx29 cell, one draw without replacement from the 3 nearest same-side sensory neurons (superclass vnc_sensory, subclass leg, acetylcholine, non-modulatory, not SNxx29) by outgoing synapse count; whole draws repeated from the seeded generator until total outgoing synapses are within 10%. Same cells as 'random-matched' for this seed; the drive gain is calibrated separately so the population spike rate matches SNxx29 (see the dose calibration record).

snch01.selection_rule: Exact type == "SNch01"; side from rootSide, not required to be symmetric; acetylcholine model transmitter.
snch01.identity_evidence: SNch01 abdominal population used as the connectomically best-supported proxy for the published ppk+/class-IV (c4da) abdominal multidendritic (md) nociceptors. The MANC systematic annotation study (Cheong et al., eLife 2024, reviewed preprint 97766) names SNch01 as the leading candidate match for these cells and groups it with SNxx29 in a connectivity/morphology cluster plausibly related to aversive stimuli. Some SNch01 instances outside the abdomen (e.g. wing-margin gustatory bristles) are a different body region of the same type name; this population is filtered to subclass == "abdomen" specifically to exclude them. This is a probable, not a demonstrated, identity.

snch01-random-matched.selection_rule: For each SNch01 cell, one draw without replacement from the 3 nearest same-side sensory neurons (superclass vnc_sensory, subclass abdomen, acetylcholine, non-modulatory, not SNch01) by outgoing synapse count; whole draws repeated from the seeded generator until total outgoing synapses are within 15%.

snch01-random-dose-matched.selection_rule: For each SNch01 cell, one draw without replacement from the 3 nearest same-side sensory neurons (superclass vnc_sensory, subclass abdomen, acetylcholine, non-modulatory, not SNch01) by outgoing synapse count; whole draws repeated from the seeded generator until total outgoing synapses are within 15%. Same cells as 'snch01-random-matched' for this seed; the drive gain is calibrated separately so the population spike rate matches SNch01 (see the dose calibration record).
